velleius-livius: Velleius Paterculus, Roman History 2.117.2 on Varus in Syria, F. W. Shipley's English translation, as given at Livius.org (livius.org/sources/content/paterculus-on-the-battle-in-the-teutoburg-forest/). Read 3 November 2026.
wiki-lucilius-bassus: "Lucilius Bassus," English Wikipedia, read 3 November 2026: it treats the prefect of the Ravenna and Misenum fleets and the legate of Judea as one man, citing Tacitus's Histories for the fleet command, without an argument for the identity.
